string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_LUNAR_SCROLL_SHIELD_ALL_20A_DESC
string.body: Oh dear. You've attracted the attention of Dragon Lord Beritra. Things are bound to be difficult this year, unless you can get rid of this card somehow.\nReading this fortune will allow you to absorb up to [%e1.Shield.CoverValue] damage per physical attack, up to a total of [%e1.Shield.CoverValue] damage, for [%e1.Shield.RemainTime].

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_LUNAR_SCROLL_SHIELD_ALL_30A_DESC
string.body: The Lord Israphel has his eye on you. He's a decent patron to have, but perhaps you could do better?\nReading this fortune will allow you to absorb up to [%e1.Shield.CoverValue] damage per physical attack, up to a total of [%e1.Shield.CoverValue] damage, for [%e1.Shield.RemainTime].

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_LUNAR_SCROLL_SHIELD_ALL_40A_DESC
string.body: The Lady Siel watches over you.\nReading this scroll will allow you to absorb up to [%e1.Shield.CoverValue] damage per physical attack, up to a total of [%e1.Shield.CoverValue] damage, for [%e1.Shield.RemainTime].

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_LUNAR_SCROLL_SHIELD_ALL_50A_DESC
string.body: Aion himself has bestowed his grace on you for the coming year.\nReading this fortune will allow you to absorb up to [%e1.Shield.CoverValue] damage per physical attack, up to a total of [%e1.Shield.CoverValue] damage, for [%e1.Shield.RemainTime].

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_2HSWORD_D_N_U1_35B_DESC
string.body: This greatsword's structural integrity seems questionable. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_2HSWORD_N_C1_18A_DESC
string.body: If you can drag this club off the ground, it might make a worthy weapon. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_2HSWORD_N_E1_50A_DESC
string.body: This greatsword is surprisingly elegant. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_2HSWORD_N_L1_A_25A_DESC
string.body: The skill of the craftsman who made this greatsword is obvious. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_2HSWORD_N_U1_44A_DESC
string.body: This greatsword does not seem too happy about its situation. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_BOOK_D_N_U1_35B_DESC
string.body: There doesn't seem to be anything wrong with this tome. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_BOOK_N_E1_50A_DESC
string.body: This tome is functional, though it will be difficult to fit on your bookshelf. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_BOOK_N_L1_A_25A_DESC
string.body: A tome that for some reason is severely crumpled and tattered, and is available only on April Fool's Day.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_BOOK_N_U1_44A_DESC
string.body: This tome seems perfectly usable, if you don't mind strange looks. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_BOW_D_N_U1_35B_DESC
string.body: Pray to Aion you don't trip and fall on this spiky bow. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_BOW_N_E1_50A_DESC
string.body: Don't you love seeing your enemies bristle with your arrows? Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_BOW_N_L1_A_25A_DESC
string.body: Can't wait to show off all your new bowstrings? This is the weapon for you! Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_BOW_N_U1_44A_DESC
string.body: This leafy bow is made from wood that's still green. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_DAGGER_D_N_U1_35B_DESC
string.body: This blade is wickedly serrated. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_DAGGER_N_E1_50A_DESC
string.body: This dagger looks normal enough. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_DAGGER_N_L1_A_25A_DESC
string.body: Instead of poison, coat your dagger in economical rust! Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_DAGGER_N_U1_44A_DESC
string.body: This sleek little dagger looks like it's sprouting. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MACE_D_N_U1_35B_DESC
string.body: Now you can bash skulls with another skull! Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MACE_N_C1_18A_DESC
string.body: The most interesting warhammer you've ever seen. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MACE_N_E1_50A_DESC
string.body: This warhammer will certainly make people forget about that one incident with the Ribbit. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MACE_N_L1_A_25A_DESC
string.body: Inspire strong reactions with this unique warhammer. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MACE_N_U1_44A_DESC
string.body: This warhammer proves you can make anything into a weapon. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_ORB_D_N_U1_35B_DESC
string.body: This eerie jewel grimaces at your foes. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_ORB_N_E1_50A_DESC
string.body: If you count this orb's tiny winged monster amongst your friends... you'll have a friend! Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_ORB_N_L1_A_25A_DESC
string.body: A jewel with an artistic crackling pattern. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_ORB_N_U1_44A_DESC
string.body: Be careful to keep this jewel out of the reach of hungry Elrocos. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_POLEARM_D_N_U1_35B_DESC
string.body: You can now live your dream of using a Jotun's stern face as a weapon. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_POLEARM_N_E1_50A_DESC
string.body: This spear's wicked blade is sure to impress your friends. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_POLEARM_N_L1_A_25A_DESC
string.body: This spear has not one, but three balance points! Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_POLEARM_N_U1_44A_DESC
string.body: A spear is a spear is a spear. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_STAFF_D_N_U1_35B_DESC
string.body: This staff is so elaborate it's likely to dazzle your enemies. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_STAFF_N_C1_18A_DESC
string.body: This staff's power is evident to anyone who sees it. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_STAFF_N_E1_50A_DESC
string.body: This staff is nice to look at, though complicated to swing. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_STAFF_N_L1_A_25A_DESC
string.body: A fine staff for Daevas who love a challenge! Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_STAFF_N_U1_44A_DESC
string.body: Sure, why not use this staff? Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_SWORD_N_C1_18A_DESC
string.body: This sword's maker is a master...at something. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_SWORD_N_E1_50A_DESC
string.body: This sword might finally make your mother proud of you. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_SWORD_N_L1_A_25A_DESC
string.body: A sword that tells the world you aren't compensating for anything. Available Fool's Day only.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_SWORD_N_U1_44A_DESC
string.body: There's no reason this sword shouldn't work just fine. Available Fool's Day only.

string.body: A warm ale with a superb smooth taste.\nDrink it when you are feeling cold and your [%e1.StatUp.StatName] and [%e2.StatUp.StatName] increase by [%e1.StatUp.Value] and [%e2.StatUp.Value] points respectively for [%e1.StatUp.RemainTime].

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_HALLOWEEN2011_FOOD_2STATS_50B_DESC
string.body: A warm ale with a great bitter taste.\nDrink it when you are feeling cold and your [%e1.StatUp.StatName] and [%e2.StatUp.StatName] increase by [%e1.StatUp.Value] and [%e2.StatUp.Value] points respectively for [%e1.StatUp.RemainTime].

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_HALLOWEEN2011_DESC
string.body: A yearbook with school pictures of Blair and Witchta, two witches who are embarrassed about their teenage appearance. Won't they be thrilled to see this?\nOpen the album to absorb a maximum of [%e1.Shield.CoverValue] damage per physical attack you receive for [%e1.Shield.RemainTime].

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_WINTER2011_01A_DESC
string.body: Crab Fest prize! The Potcrabs love you today.\nDouble-click to open the bundle.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_WINTER2011_02A_DESC
string.body: Prizes await in the shape of Aion's Star.\nDouble-click to break it open!

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER2011_FOOD_HPREGEN_20A_DESC
string.body: It's a stunned Potcrab. Collect a few and exchange them for a present from Sunshine or Glimma.\nUsing it increases your [%e1.StatUp.StatName] by [%e1.StatUp.Value] points for [%e1.StatUp.RemainTime].

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER2011_FOOD_MPREGEN_20A_DESC

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_HALLOWEEN_XPBOOST_02_DESC
string.body: You gain 20%% additional XP from hunting, gathering, and crafting while the Witch's Night is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_PARALYZE_R2_50A_DESC
string.body: Imbues your weapon with an effect that has a 2%% chance to paralyze your target for 3 seconds.\nDouble-click (or right-click) the Godstone to activate it, and then click the item on which to socket the Godstone.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_SILENCE_R2_50A_DESC
string.body: Imbues your weapon with an effect that has a 5%% chance to silence your target for 5 seconds.\nDouble-click (or right-click) the Godstone to activate it, and then click the item on which to socket the Godstone.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_BLIND_R2_50A_DESC
string.body: Imbues your weapon with an effect that has a 5%% chance to blind your target for 5 seconds.\nDouble-click (or right-click) the Godstone to activate it, and then click the item on which to socket the Godstone.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_FIRE_DAMAGE_R2_50A_DESC
string.body: Imbues your weapon with an effect that has a 2%% chance to inflict 750 points of fire damage on your target.\nDouble-click (or right-click) the Godstone to activate it, and then click the item on which to socket the Godstone.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_EARTH_DAMAGE_R2_50A_DESC
string.body: Imbues your weapon with an effect that has a 2%% chance to inflict 750 points of earth damage on your target.\nDouble-click (or right-click) the Godstone to activate it, and then click the item on which to socket the Godstone.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_POISON_R2_50A_DESC
string.body: Imbues your weapon with an effect that has a 10%% chance to inflict 38 points of poison damage on your target every 2 seconds for 16 seconds.\nDouble-click (or right-click) the Godstone to activate it, and then click the item on which to socket the Godstone.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_BLEED_R2_50A_DESC
string.body: Imbues your weapon with an effect that has a 8%% chance to inflict 71 points of bleed damage on your target every 2 seconds for 8 seconds.\nDouble-click (or right-click) the Godstone to activate it, and then click the item on which to socket the Godstone.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_WEAPON_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Balaur's training weapon.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_JEWELBOX_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a jewelry box that Lady Angerr holds dear.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_SHULACKSHIP_C_01_DESC
string.body: A replica of the Steel Rake, the great Shulack ship.\nThe craftsmanship is remarkable, and shows details that most artists couldn't hope to make out.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_GOLDSAAM_C_01_DESC
string.body: Aged Ginseng that emits a slightly bitter scent.\nFunctions well as potpourri, but has little other purpose.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_REFUGEDOLL_C_01_DESC
string.body: A shabby doll clearly made by Shulack hands.\nThere are no clues as to whether or not the toy was made for someone in particular.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_SIEGEWEAPON_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a replica of a weapon from the Varsharti Legion.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_TIAMATCRACk_C_01_DESC
string.body: This jewel signifies fissures.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_TIAMATGRAVITY_C_01_DESC
string.body: This jewel signifies gravity.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_TIAMATRAGE_C_01_DESC
string.body: This jewel signifies wrath.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_TIAMATCRYSTAL_C_01_DESC
string.body: This jewel signifies petrification.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_SHULACKPLANE_C_01_DESC
string.body: A replica of a Steam Tachysphere.\nIt is based on the design of an actual Steam Tachysphere, however, the joints' functions are limited, preventing some degrees of movement.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_STIGMAL_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a stigma stone replica.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_BURNER_C_01_DESC
string.body: This beautiful crystal ball shimmers with Aether.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_DRADGIONL_C_01_DESC
string.body: A miniature replica of the latest Dredgion.\nYou can make out a Gravity Controller, the Dredgion Core, and even a Photon Cannon. With such remarkable detail, it wouldn't be all that surprising to find miniature Balaur working away inside.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_ODRECEIVER_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is an Obelisk inside a transparent cube, an angular accent piece.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_PEARL_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a clam containing beautiful pearls.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_COMAD_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Komad model that reminds you of your exploits within Taloc's Hollow.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_CANDYBASKET_C_01_DESC
string.body: This lovely basket contains liquor, fruit, and mushrooms.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_PORTALTRIGGER_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a replica of the Krall's guardian stone.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_STIGMAD_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a stigma replica.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_DRADGIOND_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: A miniature replica of the latest Dredgion.\nYou can make out a Gravity Controller, the Dredgion Core, and even a Photon Cannon. With such remarkable detail, it wouldn't be all that surprising to find miniature Balaur working away inside.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_ADMADOLL_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: A little teddy bear that originally belonged to Seiren Ntuamu.\nSadly, Princess Karemiwen took everything from Ntuamu, including Lannok's love, and the bear.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_TELEPORTERRUG_C_01_DESC
string.body: A rug with the magic ward of movement pattern on it.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_MANDURI_LIGHT_C_01_DESC
string.body: This lighting is made of the branches from which condor eggs dangle.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_FLAG_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is an insignia for winning a war.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_DRAGON_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a Tahabata replica.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_RUDRA_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Stormwing statuette.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_RAKSHA_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Raksha statuette.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_ELEMENTALKING_C_01_DESC
string.body: A model of the terrible Yamennes, the mightiest creature within the Abyssal Splinter.\nEven though the model is a fraction of Yamennes' size, the sculptor still managed to convey the beast's unbridled fury.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_KRALLDRUM_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is Chieftain Kraka's drum.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_TESINON_C_01_DESC
string.body: A model of the Fourth Weapon, Dorhan.\nIt is staring at you as if it were about to eat you alive.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_DAILYNPCSL_C_01_DESC
string.body: A lovely statue of the Arachne Sisters.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_COREBATTERY_C_01_DESC
string.body: An Elemental Core created from the Powers of the Four Spirits.\nIt is a valuable item that shows the powers of the purified spirit that Theobomos created.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_PORGUSS_C_01_DESC
string.body: This replica celebrates the return of Poppy, Cannon's pet Porgus.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_ATREIA_C_01_DESC
string.body: A replica of all Atreia.\nThe level of detail is quite remarkable, and can be used for strategic planning if needed.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_OD_BOMB_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a non-lethal replica of an Aether bomb.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_UNDEADLIGHT_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: A statue of the Betrayer Villaire.\nVillaire was once a member of the Red Sky Legion, but abandoned his comrades after being tempted by material things.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_DAILYNPCSD_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: A handsome statue of the Marchutan Brothers.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.body: [Souvenir] Scroll of Four Dragons' Dauntless Spirit

string.name: STR_DECE_ACHIEVE_LF2CITATION_C_01_DESC
string.body: A framed commendation given by the Brigade General.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECE_ACHIEVE_LF1PAINTING_C_01_DESC
string.body: An oil painting depicting the beautiful Cliona Lake.\nThe bright and warm strokes add luster to the peaceful scenes, and remind you of your life before your ascension.

string.name: STR_DECE_ACHIEVE_DRAGONSCROLL_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a dragon scroll of good fortune.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECE_ACHIEVE_SHUGOPAINTING_C_01_DESC
string.body: A stunning painting of a Shugo.\nThe gentle smile and slightly turned face, combined with dark and deep eyes gives the subject of the painting a real sense of identity.

string.name: STR_DECE_ACHIEVE_DF2CITATION_C_01_DESC
string.body: A framed commendation given by the Brigade General.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECE_ACHIEVE_DF1PAINTING_C_01_DESC
string.body: An oil painting depicting Lake Tunapre.\nThe dark and cold colors give the piece a strange, dreamlike feel. It's a shame that the creator's identity is unknown.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_MIRROR_C_01_DESC
string.body: A mirror that feels--even looks--cold.\nKromede, the lady of sad fortune, actually used this mirror in the great Fire Temple.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_COFFIN_C_01_DESC
string.body: An accessory modeled after the coffin in Beshmundir Temple.\nYou feel a sense of foreboding around it, and the rattling sound occasionally heard inside it is enough to raise your hairs.

string.name: STR_WORLD_ALL_BOOST_FULL_DAY_1_DESC

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_ATREIA_01_DESC
string.body: It is an Atreia piece containing the scent of spring.\nObtainable only in spring.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_ATREIA_02_DESC
string.body: It is an Atreia piece containing the scent of summer.\nObtainable only in summer.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_ATREIA_03_DESC
string.body: It is an Atreia piece containing the scent of fall.\nObtainable only in fall.\nWhen the remainder of the pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_ATREIA_04_DESC
string.body: It is an Atreia piece containing the scent of winter.\nObtainable only in winter.\nWhen the remainder of the pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGONSCROLL_01_DESC
string.body: This scroll piece vividly displays the blazing sparks of Raksha.\nObtainable only in spring.\nWhen the remainder of the pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGONSCROLL_02_DESC
string.body: This scroll piece describes Tahabata's roar in great detail.\nObtainable only in summer.\nWhen the remainder of the pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGONSCROLL_03_DESC
string.body: This special scroll frame can hold the drawings of the Balaur, and forms part of a set.\nObtainable only in fall.\nWhen the remainder of the pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGONSCROLL_04_DESC
string.body: This scroll piece vividly describes the cold eyes of Stormwing.\nObtainable only in winter.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_SHUGOPAINTING_01_DESC
string.body: It is a piece of an elaborate portrait of a Shugo.\nObtainable only in spring.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_SHUGOPAINTING_02_DESC
string.body: It is a bust portrait of a prim Shugo.\nObtainable only in summer.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_SHUGOPAINTING_03_DESC
string.body: It is a piece of a drawing depicting a Shugo's glimmering earrings in detail.\nObtainable only in fall.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_SHUGOPAINTING_04_DESC
string.body: It is a piece of a drawing that beautifully depicts a Shugo's turban.\nObtainable only in winter.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSL_C_01_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Typhon, president of the Alabaster Order.\nThe words "Pure White Elegance Edition" are etched into the art.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSL_C_02_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Pompo, a Radiant Ops recruiter.\nHis features have been well represented here, and the pose he's pulling off looks very typical of Pompo.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSL_C_03_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Juris Po, captain of the Fortuneers.\nThe model is very accurate, and features his penetrating eyes and wide-brimmed hat.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSL_C_04_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Jiyunia.\nHer laid back attitude has been well represented in the model, mostly through her loosely crossed arms and casual pose. She's every bit as attractive here as in the skin.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSD_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Deryk, registrar of the Field Wardens.\nHis face are hidden behind the brilliant green armor that he wears.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSD_D_C_02_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Viscum, commander of the Blood Crusade.\nA roaring posture to the sky imparts a strong sense of spirited ambitions.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSD_D_C_03_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Tikalanerk, a beautiful member of Charlirunerk's Daemons.\nThis would make a fine decoration for your home.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSD_D_C_04_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Petrarca, manager of The Circle.\nPetty burglars like the Ulgorn Raiders would turn tail after coming under Petrarca's murderous gaze.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGON_01_DESC
string.body: The head of Tahabata.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGON_02_DESC
string.body: The skeleton of Tahabata.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGON_03_DESC
string.body: The wings of Tahabata.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_RUDRA_01_DESC
string.body: The head of Stormwing.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_RUDRA_02_DESC
string.body: The skeleton of Stormwing.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_RUDRA_03_DESC
string.body: The wings of Stormwing.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_RAKSHA_01_DESC
string.body: The head of Raksha.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_RAKSHA_02_DESC
string.body: A skeleton of Raksha.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_RAKSHA_03_DESC
string.body: The wings of Raksha.\nFind the other two for the complete form that can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_DRAGON_C_01_DESC
string.body: A wall decoration modeled on the great Tahabata.\nThe craftsmanship is so exquisite that it looks ready to spew fire from its mouth any instant.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_RUDRA_C_01_DESC
string.body: A wall decoration modeled on Stormwing, the self-declared sixth Dragon Lord.\nStare at it long enough, and it looks as though it moves before your very eyes.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_RAKSHA_C_01_DESC
string.body: A wall decoration modeled on Raksha's twisted anger.\nRaksha was once powerful enough to challenge Tiamat himself. Sadly for him, Tiamat was significantly stronger.

string.name: STR_WORLD_XP_BOOST_06_DESC
string.body: You gain 100%% additional XP from gathering, crafting, and hunting creatures while this effect is active.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_XPBOOST_06_DESC
string.body: You gain 50%% additional XP from gathering, crafting, and hunting creatures while Berdin's 50%% XP Amulet II is active.\nThe effect lasts 1 hour, and has an additional 1 hour cooldown.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_XPBOOST_07_DESC
string.body: You gain 100%% additional XP from gathering, crafting, and hunting creatures while Berdin's 100%% XP Amulet II is active.\nThe effect lasts 1 hour, and has an additional 1 hour cooldown.

string.name: STR_JUNK_DAILYGATHER_SHELL_01_DESC
string.body: Inside the shell, a beautiful pearl awaits.

string.name: STR_JUNK_DAILYGATHER_STONE_01_DESC
string.body: A shining by-product of Aether ore extraction.

string.name: STR_JUNK_DAILYGATHER_PLANT_01_DESC
string.body: A flower that symbolizes the natural cycle. Nepera in Oriel's Green Forest Trail Village is desperately seeking it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50A_DESC
string.body: Dukiron's first-ever work.\nIt demonstrates the aesthetics of self-control and restraint, rather than flamboyant exuberance.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50B_DESC
string.body: The fish that took Liuron half a day to catch.\nIts looks as powerful and as huge as a Balaur soldier, though obviously is a good deal tastier.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50C_DESC
string.body: Makron crafted this decorative item after being inspired by blazing flames.\nIt is not as hot as it looks!

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50D_DESC
string.body: The gently reflecting light is simply exquisite.\nEuron once accidentally dropped a pick on it, but fortunately there wasn't a single scratch on it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50E_DESC
string.body: Sniron used to take scores of these vegetables to snack on in-between meals.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50F_DESC
string.body: It was originally made as a gift for Makron, but Makron flew off the handle because he thought it was a waste of precious ore. It had to be discarded.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50G_DESC
string.body: Kashuron disliked eating vegetables so much that he hid them in a secret place, where they grew larger and larger.\nYou should probably keep these away from children.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50H_DESC
string.body: The pages in the notebook were made by processing several wide leaves.\nThese were used before the days of paper, and are still used where wood is hard to come by.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50I_DESC
string.body: The beautiful flower buds put even the most vigilant of soldiers at ease.\nUnfortunate then, that the stalks can strike out with such deadly force.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50J_DESC
string.body: A basic musical instrument made by weaving twigs together.\nSkilled musicians can make something tuneful from it, but most find it better used as a basic type of bow.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55A_DESC
string.body: Dukiron thought this brooch took after his look.\nIt's impossibly flamboyant, and Dukiron is totally mesmerized by it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55B_DESC
string.body: Its scales and teeth were so sharp that it can't be caught with a regular fishing line.\nPseron finally caught it using a special fishing line made from vines.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55C_DESC
string.body: Makron made this accessory as he was inspired by the flashing thunderbolt that was falling from dark clouds.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55D_DESC
string.body: Mikaron made this plate by engraving personally-designed patterns and inserting jewels that he crafted.\nHis attention to detail is phenomenal.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55E_DESC
string.body: This vegetable's peel is so tough and hard that not many have the perseverance to get to the fruit inside.\nHowever, Fat Sniron would peel it off with much gusto.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55F_DESC
string.body: Euron's favored mining pick.\nMakron changed the handle once, though Euron failed to notice any difference.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55G_DESC
string.body: A vegetable that Kashuron dislikes. This one has hardened considerably.\nThe awful smell is excellent at repelling harmful bugs.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55H_DESC
string.body: It is a notebook made from the fruits around Tyron's home.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55I_DESC
string.body: A flower that Pseron cultivated with all her love for Dukiron.\nJust like her heart heads towards Dukiron, this flower grows towards the direction of the Tower of Eternity.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55J_DESC
string.body: A musical instrument that Hudaron used to play while sitting in his favorite tree.\nIt has only one string but has a beautiful tone to it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60A_DESC
string.body: Dukiron was haunted by an terrible sense of jealousy after completing this brooch.\nIt defied his belief that nothing more beautiful than himself could exist.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60B_DESC
string.body: This is the biggest fish that Liuron has ever caught in his whole life.\nIt was so big that Fat Sniron lost his mind over it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60C_DESC
string.body: An accessory Makron made while mulling over the harmony between fire and water, and other contrasting properties.\nMakron was greatly enlightened once he completed the accessory.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60D_DESC
string.body: A beautiful plate featuring five bold colors.\nYou can hear the gentle rush of the sea when you place your ear next to it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60E_DESC
string.body: A snack that Fat Sniron kept deep inside his cave for he fear someone might take it.\nHe ended up leaving it for so long that it turned too hard to eat.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60F_DESC
string.body: An axe that Euron only used when cutting down the largest trees he could find.\nThough overly heavy, it has a soft and comfortable grip.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60G_DESC
string.body: A toy made by further hardening rotten vegetables. Yuck!

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60H_DESC
string.body: A notebook with pages made from thinly sliced pieces of fruit.\nEven though old, it still smells rather sweet.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60I_DESC
string.body: This flower was wasting away without having to bloom once. But Pseron's dedicated care has given it the life of eternity.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60J_DESC
string.body: An instrument with strings made from flowers and leaves. How strange.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50A_DESC
string.body: Dukiron's first-ever work.\nIt demonstrates the beauty of self-control rather than flamboyance.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50B_DESC
string.body: The fish that took Liuron half a day to catch.\nIts looks as powerful and as huge as a Balaur soldier, though obviously is a good deal tastier.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50C_DESC
string.body: Makron crafted this decorative item after being inspired by blazing flames.\nIt is not as hot as it looks!

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50D_DESC
string.body: The gently reflecting light is simply exquisite.\nEuron once accidentally dropped a pick on it, but fortunately there wasn't a single scratch on it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50E_DESC
string.body: Sniron used to take scores of these vegetables to snack on in-between meals.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50F_DESC
string.body: It was originally made as a gift for Makron, but Makron flew off the handle because he thought it was a waste of precious ore. It had to be discarded.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50G_DESC
string.body: Kashuron disliked eating vegetables so much that he hid them in a secret place, where they grew larger and larger.\nYou should probably keep these away from children.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50H_DESC
string.body: The pages in the notebook were made by processing several wide leaves.\nThese were used before the days of paper, and are still used where wood is hard to come by.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50I_DESC
string.body: The beautiful flower buds put even the most vigilant of soldiers at ease.\nUnfortunate then, that the stalks can strike out with such deadly force.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50J_DESC
string.body: A basic musical instrument made by weaving twigs together.\nSkilled musicians can make something tuneful from it, but most find it better used as a basic type of bow.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_55A_DESC
string.body: Dukiron thought this brooch took after his look.\nIt's impossibly flamboyant, and Dukiron is totally mesmerized by it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_55B_DESC
string.body: Its scales and teeth were so sharp that it can't be caught with a regular fishing line.\nPseron finally caught it using a special fishing line made from vines.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_55C_DESC
string.body: Makron made this accessory as he was inspired by the flashing thunderbolt that was falling from dark clouds.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_55D_DESC
string.body: Mikaron made this plate by engraving personally-designed patterns and inserting jewels that he crafted.\nHis attention to detail is phenomenal.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_55E_DESC
string.body: This vegetable's peel is so tough and hard that not many have the perseverance to get to the fruit inside.\nHowever, Fat Sniron would peel it off with much gusto.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_55F_DESC
string.body: Euron's favored mining pick.\nMakron changed the handle once, though Euron failed to notice any difference.

Tahabata Egg.
It cooks and uses magical items automatically for you.
It picks up items while you're in battle.
You can hatch this at a Pet Minder.
You can keep the adopted pet for 7 days.

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_Prod_U_LITTLESHUGOMFORTUNE_01_7DAY_DESC

A Lukeshunerk Egg.
The pet hatching from this egg gives you a bundle of fortune items and consumables when fed.
Visit a Pet Distributor to hatch the egg.
You can keep the pet for 7 days.

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_WARE_U_LITTLESHUGOMSANTA_01_DESC

Solorinerk Egg.
A 24-space pet pouch.
Uses your cooking and magic items automatically.
You can hatch this at a Pet Minder.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_BED_55A_DESC
string.body: It is a bed decorated with Queen Klawnickt's visage. How could anyone sleep with that thing staring at them?

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_BED_55B_DESC
string.body: A bed that was modeled after Turatu's features. Even though it looks kinda wet, it's actually really, really comfortable.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_55A_DESC
string.body: A seat modeled on Skuma Silvereye's features.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_55B_DESC
string.body: A seat modeled on Elder Narikiki's features. It's pure comfort, no matter how you sit on it.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_D_55A_DESC
string.body: A seat modeled on Chieftain Ulagu's features. It feels snug and comfortable, though the beak is a bit distracting.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_D_55B_DESC
string.body: A seat modeled on Gravekeeper Basaim's features. The head sculpture is beaming with bluish eyes, radiating an ominous vibe. It should be effective for repelling burglars and thieves.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_BED_60A_DESC
string.body: A bed blessed with the protection of the Spirit of Tranquility. It resonates with a calming warmth.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_BED_60B_DESC
string.body: A stone bed decorated with Daturum's bust. More functional than comfortable, this bed is recommended for any Daevas concerned about their spinal health.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_60A_DESC
string.body: A lighting stand that was remodeled to look like Captain Babelkin's helmet. The words "Made in the Kaichin Engineering Union" are engraved on the inside of the stand.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_60B_DESC
string.body: A couch imbued with the raw power of Vanuka the Earthshaker. Creepy!

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_CHAIR_60A_DESC
string.body: A chair that couldn't be more comfortable if it tried.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_CHAIR_60B_DESC
string.body: A chair inspired by the features of Ironjaw Tarapu. As interesting as it looks, it doesn't look all that comfortable.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_RUG_60A_DESC
string.body: A wall-mounted decoration made from the skin of Gabo the Obstinate. It is a flawless, top-quality product with fine fur and sharp horns.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_RUG_60B_DESC
string.body: A wall-mounted decoration inspired by the features of Insidious Barolf. Scary stuff.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_01A_DESC
string.body: You can fly even if you've only got one wing. Have faith and dedicate yourself to everything you do.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_02A_DESC
string.body: You feel as though you could obtain Aether from the very air around you. Only committed efforts breed hope.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_03A_DESC
string.body: You have lots of obstacles to overcome, but a helper will appear to get you out of trouble.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_04A_DESC
string.body: Consider how the mother Brax responds to the cries of her young Braxie. You carry destiny on your shoulders.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_05A_DESC
string.body: Stop your worries over slow growth. You only have to worry if you stop moving.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while the charm remains active.\nThis effect expires after 30 minutes, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_06A_DESC
string.body: You may have anxieties on the outside, but feel pleasant on the inside. Rest yourself for comfort and wellbeing.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_07A_DESC
string.body: The grass lies as the wind blows. Remain committed to your party leader and you'll be compensated in more ways than one.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_08A_DESC
string.body: Consider how Kirrin cross water. You can't ford your way across without your tail getting wet.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_09A_DESC
string.body: You change your equipment according to the changing season, according to the changing needs of your situation. Everything thus falls into place.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_10A_DESC
string.body: Much like the Ribbit, cross the biggest rivers, the toughest challenges. Only then will disasters and hardships be vanquished.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_11A_DESC
string.body: While stars appear in broad daylight, they retreat so far from the sun that they cannot be seen. When the sun appears under water, it is difficult to get it to brighten up the outlook of your ongoing trials.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_12A_DESC
string.body: Cooking raw food requires changing it entirely. Only when it's done, will the scent and taste you desire will be obtained.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_13A_DESC
string.body: Daru changes to become Kirrin. You should mend old things and adopt new things. You cannot pour new wine into an old, dirty skin.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_14A_DESC
string.body: An auspicious bird is flying high, promising something better for you. A small seed will sprout slowly, so slowly, into a mighty tree.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_15A_DESC
string.body: It wasn't the item you desired, but perhaps it desired you. Nothing was ever guaranteed, so making the best of your opportunities leads you to something more.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_16A_DESC
string.body: It is as easy as slashing through Spriggs with a Master Orichalcum Dagger. It may look like a loss at first, but will turn out to be a blessing in disguise later on.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_17A_DESC
string.body: The male Brax leans against the fence, rather than carrying its own weight. It is not going to be advantageous for you, so stop seeking support, because whatever help you gain will be minor, indeed.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_18A_DESC
string.body: A flower is about to bloom on a winter tree. Even if you firmly discipline your mind and move forward, you should consider yourself lucky if only half of what you have wished for becomes realized.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_19A_DESC
string.body: The ground rumbles, a Sparkle appears and strikes its wings together. Everything under the sun flows to you so easily, and nothing can go wrong at this point.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_20A_DESC
string.body: A wolf may pass easily among docile sheep. Beware evil intent disguised by beauty. If you keep your heart pure, everything will fall into place.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_21A_DESC
string.body: As fishes seek calm pools in which to play, you get to share an item with your closest Daeva. Everything you desire will be yours. How can you not like everything?\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_22A_DESC
string.body: Although you acquired a Eternal item, it doesn't belong to your class. Its greater force instead drags you down, slowing your reactions. If you keep your heart pure and stay focused on who you are, everything will fall into place.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_23A_DESC
string.body: You attack with the strength of several Daeva at once. The number of foes won't be a problem for you. Petty minds should avoid using this.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_24A_DESC
string.body: You continue to pursue Drakie, but you really need to find Daru. Chasing a habit prevents you from seeking something better.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_01B_DESC
string.body: A fair wind is blowing in your direction, everything starts to prosper, and your honorable reputation becomes even more elevated.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 20%% while the charm remains active.\nThis effect expires after 30 minutes, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_02B_DESC
string.body: A path of open wind and water droplets form a bridge across the heavens. If you have a destination to reach, it is definitely an auspicious sign.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 20%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_03B_DESC
string.body: Swords are returned to their sheaths in respect, and you are presented to an Empyrean Lord. Nothing can hinder what you do, because all will be well.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 20%% while the charm remains active.\nThis effect expires after 30 minutes, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_04B_DESC
string.body: Imagine Stormwing and Tahabata fighting each other in front of your eyes. Even the youngest Daeva will achieve two goals in a single attempt.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 20%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_05B_DESC
string.body: You ride on flooding river water to traverse hundreds of miles in a heartbeat. Even the smallest wing will fly you to your goal.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 20%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_IDRAKSHA_GLOVESHOES_01_DESC
string.body: A Guestbloom obtained from Raksang.\nWhen well maintained, often with Guestbloom Fertilizers, this Guestbloom can give you a pair of boots or gloves from the legendary Raksha Legionary.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_IDYUN_GLOVESHOES_01_DESC
string.body: A Guestbloom obtained from the Rentus Base.\nWhen well maintained, often with Guestbloom Fertilizers, this Guestbloom can give you a pair of boots or gloves from the Resistance Army.

string.name: STR_ITEM_OWNERTREE_TREASURE_04D_01_DESC
string.body: Grants the house owner a Lesser Ancient Icon once per day when tended with Hearthbloom Fertilizer.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_IDCORE_COSTUME_01_DESC
string.body: When well maintained, often with Guestbloom Fertilizers, this Guestbloom can give you a piece of plate armor or, rarely, a Grateful Plate Guestbloom.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_FANATIC01_COSTUME_01_DESC
string.body: A Dragonbound Leather Costume Guestbloom.\nWhen well maintained, often with Guestbloom Fertilizers, this Guestbloom can give you a Dragonbound Leather Costume, rarely, a Dragonbound Leather Costume Guestbloom.

string.name: STR_WRAP_BIRTHCAKE_OWNER_DESC
string.body: A bundle of birthday cake slices--did you take more than your share?\nIt contains several pieces of a birthday cake, and you can double-click or right-click it to open it.

string.name: STR_WRAP_QUEST_BUTLER_GIFT_01_DESC
string.body: A gift from your butler.\nContains a Guestbloom Fertilizer. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_VISITANTTREE_IDRAKSHA_SHSGLV_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing Raksha's general goods.\nIt contains either a pair of boots or gloves. Double-click to check what's inside.

string.name: STR_WRAP_VISITANTTREE_IDYUN_SHSGLV_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing the Resistance Army's general goods.\nIt contains either a pair of boots or gloves. Double-click to open it.

string.name: STR_TEST_EVENT_FIRECRACKER_01_DESC
string.body: Fireworks full of bangs and flashes!

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_IDCORE_ch_COSTUME_01_DESC
string.body: When well maintained, often with Guestbloom Fertilizers, this Guestbloom can give you a chain armor piece or, rarely, a Grateful Chain Guestbloom.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_FANATIC01_rb_COSTUME_01_DESC
string.body: A Dragonbound Cloth Costume Guestbloom.\nWhen well maintained, often with Guestbloom Fertilizers, this Guestbloom can give you a Dragonbound Cloth Costume or, rarely, a Dragonbound Costume Guestbloom.

string.name: STR_WRAP_VISITANTTREE_LOOKCHANGE_ABYSS_PL_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing Guestbloom Gratitude Plate Armor.\nContains one of the following: breastplate, greaves, shoulderplates, sabatons, or gauntlets. Double-click (or right-click) to open it.

string.name: STR_WRAP_VISITANTTREE_LOOKCHANGE_ABYSS_CH_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing Guestbloom Gratitude Chain Armor.\nContains one of the following: hauberk, chausses, spaulders, brogans, or handguards. Double-click (or right-click) to open it.

string.name: STR_WRAP_VISITANTTREE_LOOKCHANGE_DRAGON_LT_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing Dragonbound leather armor.\nContains one of the following: jerkin, breeches, shoulderguards, boots, or vambrace. Double-click (or right-click) to open it.

string.name: STR_WRAP_VISITANTTREE_LOOKCHANGE_DRAGON_RB_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing Dragonbound cloth armor.\nContains one of the following: tunic, leggings, pauldrons, shoes, or gloves. Double-click (or right-click) to open it.

string.name: STR_WRAP_OWNERTREE_TREASURE_04D_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle Lesser Ancient Icons.\n Players from level 1 through 50 can use this. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_REFILL_ENCHANTBOX_02_DESC
string.body: Contains enchantment stones which can be used for a short period of time.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_UNIQUE_PROC_PACK_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle of unique Godstones.\nContains a variety of Fabled Godstones. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_FINAL_REWARD_CUBE_01_DESC
string.body: A mysterious box.\nContains one of the following: enchantment stone refill box (10-day coupon), unique godstone bundle, or a lucky wing feather. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_CASH_XPBOOST_03_DESC
string.body: Grants you 20%% additional XP from gathering, crafting, or hunting creatures while Lodas Amulet is active.\nThe effect expires after 2 hours, and has a cooldown of 5 hours.

string.name: STR_CASH_SCROLL_START_KIT_01B_DESC
string.body: There is no resurrection penalty or XP loss when killed. Soul healing and Flying/Teleporting/Returning to Bind Point cost only 1 Kinah. High grade soul healing incurs additional costs.

string.body: A rotten Pluma egg.\nThe smell is... well... rotten.

string.body: A smashed Pluma egg.\nIt's far too damaged to be used for the festival.

string.name: STR_JUNK_WORLD_EVENT_EASTER_FAKE_03A_DESC

A Red Bow Kobushka egg.
Automatically uses your cooking and magic items when necessary and gives you an unknown bundle when fed.
Can be obtained from a Pet Minder.
You can keep the parceled pet for 3 days.

A Big Boy Shugo egg.

You can hatch this at a Pet Minder.
Grants you a pet for 3 days.

Picks up items while you're in battle.

You can keep the parceled pet for 3 days.

string.body: An eerie-looking couch that suits the Harvest Revel Festival down to the ground.

string.name: STR_ITEM_WORLD_OWNERPOT_XMAS_DESC
string.body: A Solorius celebratory flowerpot.\nThe house owner can obtain a gift once a day if they take care of the tree.\nIf taken care of for 6 days, the tree gives a present.

string.name: STR_ITEM_WORLD_OWNERPOT_HLWN_DESC
string.body: A Harvest Revel celebratory flowerpot.\nThe house owner can obtain a gift once a day if they take care of the tree.\nIf taken care of for 6 days, the tree gives a present.

string.body: A cabinet in the shape of a small snowman.\nYou can store items here.

string.name: STR_WORLD_IVBOX_TYPEA_HLWN_DESC
string.body: A pumpkin-decorated cabinet.\nYou can store items here.

string.body: A chair replete with the spirit of the Solorius Festival.

string.name: STR_ITEM_WORLD_CHAIR_HLWM_DESC
string.body: A chair oozing with the spirit of the Harvest Revel.

string.name: STR_ITEM_WORLD_PARTION_XMAS_DESC
string.body: A Solorius partition used to divide up your house.

string.name: STR_ITEM_WORLD_PARTION_HLWN_DESC
string.body: A Harvest Revel partition used to divide up your house.

string.name: STR_WORLD_BED_XMAS_DESC
string.body: A snug bed perfect for the Solorius Festival.

string.name: STR_WORLD_BED_HLWN_DESC
string.body: A snug bed perfect for the Harvest Revel.

string.name: STR_WORLD_LIGHT_STAND_HLWN_DESC
string.body: Pumpkin lighting perfect for the Harvest Revel.

string.name: STR_WORLD_LIGHT_TABLE_HLWN_DESC
string.body: Wall lighting perfect for the Harvest Revel.

string.name: STR_WORLD_IVBOX_TYPEB_HLWN_DESC
string.body: A Harvest Revel tree cabinet.\nYou can store items here.

string.name: STR_WORLD_SHELF_HLWN_DESC
string.body: A decorative shelf perfect for the Harvest Revel.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_ITEM_VP_RECOVERY_50_DESC
string.body: A rare tea that recovers your Energy of Repose by 50%%.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_BASARTI_C_01_DESC
string.body: A wall decoration made by the gloves that Brigade General Vasharti used.\nThey still pulse with the general's formidable power.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_TIAMATDRAGON_C_01_DESC
string.body: A statue modeled after the Dragon Lord Tiamat.\nIt was the lord of earth, and the last of the five Dragon Lords to ascend.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NARIKIKI_C_01_DESC
string.body: A replica of a cat weapon.\nIt was modeled after the weapon used by Elder Narikiki in Rokoros Village.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_WLLAUOO_C_01_DESC
string.body: Chieftain Ulagu's mask.\nThe feathers are so vibrantly colored.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_TIAMATMAGE_C_01_DESC
string.body: A statue modeled after Tiamat.\nThe eyes seem to bore into you wherever you go.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_NEPILIMHAMMER_C_01_DESC
string.body: Debarim the Omnipotent's hammer.\nYou can feel the power of the mysterious minerals used to forge this hammer.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_HETGELM_C_01_DESC
string.body: A statue of a Hetgolem.\nIt almost looks cute.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_GARNON_C_01_DESC
string.body: A statue of Garnon.\nQuite an accurate likeness.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_KAISINEL_C_01_DESC
string.body: A statue of the Empyrean Lord Kaisinel.\nA guardian deity for Spiritmasters and Sorcerers as well as the lord of fantasy.\nIt exudes a sense of mercy and determination.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_MARKOOTAN_C_01_DESC
string.body: A statue of the Empyrean Lord Marchutan.\nA guardian deity for Clerics and Chanters as well as the lord of destiny. He was very close with Empyrean Lady Siel, the protector of Aion's tower, but was on bad terms with Zikel, the lord of destruction.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_PORGUSS_C_02_DESC
string.body: A statue of a pet porgus being barbecued.\nYou could swear you can almost smell an appetizing roasting aroma.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_SHELLIZARDNAMED_C_01_DESC
string.body: A statue of Andre.\nJust look at those horns!

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_CONDOR_C_01_DESC
string.body: A statue of King Consierd.\nIts glossy black feathers remind you of luxurious silk.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_ABITAS_C_01_DESC
string.body: A statue of Magic Power Crystal Ativas.\nThere is a hypnotic depth of color to the crystal.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_TATAR_C_01_DESC
string.body: A statue of Golden Tatar.\nThe monster is said to have once been a normal Gurriki, who mutated after drinking contaminated water.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_PLETOOS_C_01_DESC
string.body: A statue of Unfinished Pletus.\nBeautiful as well as functional, this automaton is inlaid with real gold.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_SCROLL_Devas_Day_L_DESC
string.body: A candle with a brilliant flame that unlocks your learning potential. Temporarily triples leveling speed for you and all nearby Daevas when placed on the Anniversary Cake.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_SCROLL_Devas_Day_D_DESC
string.body: A candle with a brilliant flame that unlocks your learning potential. Temporarily triples leveling speed for you and all nearby Daevas when placed on the Anniversary Cake.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_SCROLL_Devas_Day_L_02_DESC
string.body: An ornate candle with an alluring flame that dances methodically. Temporarily triples the drop rate for you and all nearby Daevas when placed on the Anniversary Cake.

string.body: A candle with a powerful flame that unlocks your inner strength. Restores 2,000 DP to you and all nearby Daevas when placed on the Anniversary Cake. Nearby Daevas also enjoy a 10%% increase in attack speed and a 10%% reduction in cast time for the buff's duration.

string.name: STR_VISITORTREE_MATERIAL_N_E_60A_DESC
string.body: Grants the house owner 1 Holy Drenium Crystal, and a small chance to obtain a Noble Weapon Design, when visitors help take care of it.\nRequires Guestbloom Fertilizer. This Guestbloom may be acquired by chance.

string.name: STR_VISITORTREE_MATERIAL_N_E_60C_DESC

string.name: STR_TEST_AP_EXTRACTION_01_DESC
string.body: You can use this item to extract 20%% of another item's Abyss Point value.\nDouble-click (or right-click) this item to activate it, and then select an item from which to extract Abyss Points.\nYou can only use it on a weapon item of Common class or below that is level 40 or lower.

string.name: STR_TEST_AP_EXTRACTION_02_DESC
string.body: You can use this item to extract 50%% of another item's Abyss Point value.\nDouble-click (or right-click) this item to activate it, and then select an item from which to extract Abyss Points.\nYou can use this item on Legendary class or lower armor items that are level 40 or lower.

string.name: STR_TEST_AP_EXTRACTION_03_DESC
string.body: You can use this item to extract 100%% of another item's Abyss Point value.\nDouble-click (or right-click) this item to activate it, and then select an item from which to extract Abyss Points.\nYou can use this item on Eternal class or lower accessories that are level 40 or lower.

string.name: STR_TEST_AP_EXTRACTION_04_DESC
string.body: You can use this item to extract 20%% of another item's Abyss Point value.\nDouble-click (or right-click) this item to activate it, and then select an item from which to extract Abyss Points.\nYou can use this item on Superior class or lower wing items that are level 60 or lower.

string.name: STR_TEST_AP_EXTRACTION_05_DESC
string.body: You can use this item to extract 50%% of another item's Abyss Point value.\nDouble-click (or right-click) this item to activate it, and then select an item from which to extract Abyss Points.\nYou can use it on Fabled class or lower equipment items that are level 60 or lower.

string.name: STR_TEST_AP_EXTRACTION_06_DESC
string.body: You can use this item to extract 100%% of another item's Abyss Point value.\nDouble-click (or right-click) this item to activate it, and then select an item from which to extract Abyss Points.\nYou can use this item on Fabled class or lower miscellaneous items that are level 60 or lower.

string.name: STR_TEST_AP_EXTRACTION_07_DESC
string.body: You can use this item to extract 100%% of another item's Abyss Point value.\nDouble-click (or right-click) this item to activate it, and then select an item from which to extract Abyss Points.\nYou can use this item on any Mythic class or lower items that are level 60 or lower.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_01_DESC
string.body: You'll obtain a consumables bundle if you're Elyos or crafting materials if you're Asmodian.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_02_DESC
string.body: You'll obtain a crafting material if you're Sorcerer or a mace and cane if you're Spiritmaster.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_03_DESC
string.body: You'll obtain a Cleric weapon if you're level 1 to 39, an Assassin Pauldrons if you're level 40 to 50, or a pair of Templar gloves if you're level 50 to 60.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_04_DESC
string.body: You'll obtain a Cleric weapon if you're an Elyos Gladiator/Templar or a consumables bundle if you're an Asmodian Ranger/Assassin.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_05_DESC
string.body: You'll obtain a consumables bundle if you're an Elyos level 1 to 39 or crafting materials if you're an Asmodian level of 40 to 50.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_06_DESC
string.body: You'll obtain an identification item if you're Gladiator/Templar level 1 to 39, or a level 55 Cleric weapon if you're Assassin/Ranger level 40 to 50.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_07_DESC
string.body: You'll obtain a consumables bundle if you're an Elyos Ranger/Assassin level 1 to 39 or an Assassin Pauldrons if you're an Asmodian Gladiator/Templar level 40 to 50.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_08_DESC
string.body: Grants you an item for identification.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_TEST_ITEM_MEGAPHONE_DESC
string.body: An item for testing the Amplifier. Using this item enables you to use Race chat.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_XPBOOST_10_DESC
string.body: You gain 50%% additional XP from gathering, crafting, or slaying creatures while Berdin's 50% XP Amulet IV is active.\nThe effect expires after 1 hour and has an additional 1 hour cooldown.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_XPBOOST_11_DESC
string.body: You gain 100%% additional XP from gathering, crafting, or slaying creatures while this amulet is active.\nThe effect lasts for 1 hour with a 1 hour cooldown.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_SCROLL_START_KIT_01D_7DAY_DESC
string.body: There is no resurrection penalty or XP loss when killed. Soul healing and Flying/Teleporting/Returning to Bind Point cost only 1 Kinah. High grade soul healing incurs additional costs.\nAvailable for 7 days.

string.body: The basis of alchemic magic. You can use it to convert a worthless Lead Fragment into a Key Pouch.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_ALCHEMIST_02_DESC
string.body: Lead Fragments are basic ingredients in alchemy. You can use these with an Alchemic Essence to create a Key Pouch.

string.name: STR_JUNK_WORLD_EVENT_LOTTO_VER2_01_DESC
string.body: Congratulations! Talk with Fortunerk to claim your prize of 300 million Kinah.\nPrizes may only be claimed on weekends. You must be level 10+ to cash in a winning ticket.

string.name: STR_JUNK_WORLD_EVENT_LOTTO_VER2_02_DESC
string.body: Congratulations! Talk with Fortunerk to claim your prize of 100 million Kinah.\nPrizes may only be claimed on weekends. You must be level 10+ to cash in a winning ticket.

string.name: STR_JUNK_WORLD_EVENT_LOTTO_VER2_03_DESC

string.name: STR_JUNK_WORLD_EVENT_LOTTO_VER2_04_DESC

string.name: STR_JUNK_WORLD_EVENT_LOTTO_VER2_05_DESC

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_LOTTO_BOX_INSTANCE_DESC
string.body: A scratch-off lottery ticket.\nDouble-click to scratch and reveal your prize winnings. You must be level 10+ to cash in a winning ticket.

string.body: This limited sale item can only be purchased a certain number of times per day. It can be purchased again 24 hours after the last purchase.

string.name: STR_ITEM_ALL_TITLE_265_DESC
string.body: This grants the <Quick Feet> title.\nUsing the title increases your Movement Speed by 3%%, Attack Speed by 2%%, Casting Speed by 2%%, and Weapon Damage by 3.

string.name: STR_ITEM_ALL_TITLE_266_DESC
string.body: This grants the <Dexterous Agility> title.\nUsing this title increases your Attack Speed by 2%%, Physical Crit by 8, and Weapon Damage by 3.

string.name: STR_ITEM_ALL_TITLE_267_DESC
string.body: Allows use of the <Magical Phenom> title.\nIncreases your casting speed by 2%%, and your magical critical hit and magic boosting power by 4 points and 17 points, respectively.

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_WARE_U_CAPSULECATSHAM_01_DESC
string.body: Traveling Kitter Egg.\nVisit a Pet Minder to hatch this egg and get a pet that carries 26 of your items.

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_WARE_U_CAPSULETAHABATA_01_DESC
string.body: Tahabata Egg.\nVisit a Pet Minder to hatch this egg and get a pet that carries 30 of your items.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_SCROLL_START_KIT_01C_1D_DESC
string.body: There is no resurrection penalty or XP loss when killed. Soul healing and Flying/Teleporting/Returning to Bind Point cost only 1 Kinah. High grade soul healing incurs additional costs.\nThe effect lasts 1 hour.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_DRBOOST_07_DESC
string.body: Increases the chance of obtaining items from creatures by 10%% while active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 1 hour.

string.name: STR_CASH_WEAPON_REIDENTIFY_M_65A_DESC
string.body: This consumable item may be used to retune a weapon.\nActivate it by double-clicking it, then select the item that you want to retune.\nYou can use this item on level 80 or lower Mythic weapons.

string.name: STR_CASH_ARMOR_REIDENTIFY_M_65A_DESC
string.body: This consumable item may be used to retune a piece of armor.\nActivate it by double-clicking it, then select the item that you want to retune.\nYou can use this item on level 80 or lower Mythic armors.

string.name: STR_IDF5_TD_WAR_BOOM_01_DESC
string.body: Inflicts [%e1.SpellATK_Instant.FixDamage] magical fire damage on up to 6 enemies within 15 m of a target that is within a [%First_Target_Valid_Distance] m radius of you and stuns them for [%e2.Stun.RemainTime].\nConsumes one Stun Grenade.

string.name: STR_IDF5_TD_WAR_BOOM_02_DESC
string.body: Inflicts [%e1.SpellATK_Instant.FixDamage] magical fire damage on up to 6 enemies within 15 m of a target that is within a [%First_Target_Valid_Distance] m radius of you. On castle gates, it inflicts an additional [%e1.SpellATK_Instant.AddDamage] damage. If the target is mounted on a turret, may knock the enemy off.\nConsumes one Anti-Turret Grenade.

string.name: STR_IDF5_TD_WAR_TANKKEY_01_DESC
string.body: Fuel needed to board Reserve Flame Vehicles, Reserve Trebuchets, or Pashid Aetheric Cannons and Pashid Field Guns that are on stand-by at the Iron Wall Warfront.\nBoarding a vehicle consumes one Trebuchet Fuel.

string.name: STR_IDF5_TD_WAR_FORTRESS_COMPONENT_01_DESC
string.body: Required to use skills on Reserve Flame Vehicles, Reserve Trebuchets, or Pashid Aetheric Cannons and Pashid Field Guns at the Iron Wall Warfront.\nUsing Trebuchet firing skills consumes one Cannonball.\nUsing the Siege Chariot's Spinning Ram skill does not consume any Cannonballs.
